author: Rob Tuytel

albedo.limits: Numeric packaging bound, not rendered appearance.
albedo.processing: Only original color is reencoded at quality 0.80. Original passing lossless normal and ARM maps are rehashed and reused, not reprocessed.

material.normal: OpenGL tangent normal, no green flip or data-map gamma transform.
material.mapping: World-space triplanar scale 1/1.5; preserve the provider 1.5-metre repeat.
material.mipmaps: Generated once, with vector renormalization for normals.
material.instance_tint: Near-neutral; retain 20 percent of the original generated-rock color rather than multiplying by a dark base coat.

preparation.original: First full package failed only color RMSE at quality 0.70. Normal/ARM decode and normal-length checks passed.
preparation.correction: Only color was reencoded at quality 0.80; data-map hashes were rechecked and reused. Original result/output retained.
preparation.foliage: Original default preparation body preserved. The new stone mode is separate.

geometry.scope: Material only. Preserve the published natural geological meshes, support descriptors, rigid transforms, actor authority and camera/input.
geometry.preview_mesh: The optional provider glTF mesh/buffer was not downloaded or installed. No scanned silhouette or displacement is claimed.

fallback: Missing historical source sets retain the old generated finish; partial/invalid sets report status and never claim ready.
limits: Source packaging and headless draw-consumer tests are not rendered quality, GPU performance, new traversal or human production-quality acceptance.
